title: Regulations for M1-9A Districts
previewText: In M1 Districts with an A suffix without a paired Residence District, uses listed under Use Groups IV(B), IX and X shall be limited to those permitted within M1 Districts paired with Residence Districts pursuant to the provisions of Section 123-21 (Modifications to M1 Use Regulations), inclusive.
